thread.listingTitle: Shower inside the room at Surfers Paradise, Gold Coast

messages.text: Hey, my name is Koushikh. I’m 26 years old and originally from India. I’m working full-time in hospitality as a manager, often on night shifts. I’m clean, tidy and a non-smoker. I’m really just looking for a comfortable space to rest and have some personal downtime. I’d love to be considered—please feel free to reach out if you need any more info!
